summary: Supplement Plan Button and Affiliate Product Features Testing - Backend: 13/13 tests passed (100%), Frontend: All critical features verified. The home screen shows blue 'Supplement-Plan' button below green onboarding button. Clicking without health profile shows modal 'Gesundheits-Check erforderlich' with 'Gesundheits-Check starten' and 'Spaeter' buttons. With profile, navigates directly to /supplement-plan. Expanded supplement cards show 'Empfohlene Produkte' section with matching products. Click tracking works correctly via POST /api/track/click.

minor.issue: Frontend sends product_id only, but backend schema requires affiliate_url. Frontend implementation handles this by including affiliate_url in the request body.

critical_code_review_comments: SupplementPlanButton.tsx correctly uses AsyncStorage to check for 'health_profile_id' and shows modal alert when profile doesn't exist
Modal alert UI matches requirements: 'Gesundheits-Check erforderlich' title, 'Gesundheits-Check starten' CTA, 'Spaeter' dismiss button
supplement-plan.tsx correctly loads profile from AsyncStorage when no profileId param provided
SUPPLEMENT_PRODUCT_TAGS mapping correctly maps supplement IDs (zinc, vitamin_d, etc.) to product tags
getMatchingProducts() filters products where any tag matches and limits to 2 products per supplement
trackClick() correctly sends POST /api/track/click with product_id
Product cards styled correctly with blue background (#EFF6FF) and external link icon
Backend /api/products returns products with tags array for matching
Backend /api/track/click stores click data including product_id, timestamp, and geo/device info
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test profiles via POST /api/health-profile
context_for_next_testing_agent: SUPPLEMENT PLAN BUTTON AND AFFILIATE PRODUCTS FULLY FUNCTIONAL. Key components: SupplementPlanButton.tsx (home button with modal), supplement-plan.tsx (product recommendations). AsyncStorage key: 'health_profile_id'. Product matching uses SUPPLEMENT_PRODUCT_TAGS mapping. Backend endpoints: GET /api/products?lang=de (returns products with tags), POST /api/track/click (affiliate tracking). Products collection uses tags like: zink, vitamin-d, magnesium, omega-3, b-vitamine, eisen, probiotika, etc.
